reason: Owner Quest 2 report: v11.342 significantly improved FPS, but hover selector ray ends on glove bounding box rather than glove surface and joystick pan/orbit felt inverted. Trigger/Grip continue precise original full-mesh intersection. Pan X/Y and orbit yaw/pitch signs reversed for camera-relative joystick navigation; right stick click+vertical zoom unchanged. Native source/undo preserved. 354-patch source built at 9,128,756 bytes SHA-256 7f34d4884d8491515789052b4c36a5564cdd298c5901debb9824cfe0b2dee2f6; independent actual Three.js r169 curved surface and moving skinned model test passed in Actions 42450424824 (5 hits within 0.00027–0.00349 scene units; empty ring center remains no-hit). Physical Quest 2 reticle comfort and framerate acceptance remains owner testing.
